title.narrative: Construction of Health Centers in Kwango in Democratic Republic of the Congo

description.narrative: This project aims at constructing 15 health centers and the rehabilitating of two hospital pavilions in three health zones in the province of Kwango, Democratic Republic of the Congo. UNOPS is responsible for the preliminary studies, design review and construction. \nThe objective of this project is to improve health access and health services, particularly maternity and paediatric services, in the Kwango province by constructing 15 health centers, which will replace previous constructions built with unsustainable materials; and add pavilions to two existing general hospitals in Boko and Kimbau. The construction of the health centers and pavilions will increase the facilities capacity to receive and care for patients in a region, where one health center serves an average population of 7,979 people. The project also aims to increase the quality of care received and improve the functionality of the centers and the health facilities\n
